concerns.text: FR-001 and SC-004 require a dataset of ≥200 pairs with memory <7GB. Task T013c (streaming/chunking logic) is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) and lacks a concrete implementation plan for dynamic chunking. Without this, the memory constraint cannot be satisfied.

FR-002 requires four distinct prompt templates. Task T010 (implement prompt files) is marked incomplete and explicitly states 'Do NOT create empty placeholders' yet the task itself is not checked off, implying the prompt content is missing. This blocks FR-002 execution.
FR-002 requires execution of prompts against the corpus. Task T021 (run_inference.py) is marked incomplete. Without this script, the core experimental intervention cannot occur.
FR-006 requires logging all prompts, seeds, and raw outputs. Task T025b (generate_translations_log.py) is marked incomplete. This creates a gap in reproducibility and Constitution Principle VI.

FR-003 requires translating Python unit tests to JavaScript. Task T027 (translate_tests.py) is marked incomplete. T027a only defines a strategy document but does not implement the translation logic, leaving FR-003 unfulfilled.
FR-004 requires computing cyclomatic complexity. Task T029 (compute_quality.py) is marked incomplete. No task exists to implement the ESLint complexity rule integration.
FR-005 requires statistical analysis (Chi-square, ANOVA). Task T030 (statistical_analysis.py) is marked incomplete. No task exists to implement the statistical tests or Bonferroni correction.
SC-001 and SC-002 require measuring p-values and quality metrics. Tasks T030 and T029 are incomplete, meaning the success criteria cannot be measured.

FR-003 requires recording a binary pass/fail result. Task T028 (run_node_tests.py) is marked complete, but T027 (test translation) is incomplete. The test runner cannot execute without the translated tests, breaking the FR-003 flow.
FR-002 and Edge Cases require timeout enforcement. Task T009 (timeout_utils.py) is marked incomplete. T020 and T028 depend on this utility, creating a blocking dependency for FR-002 and FR-003.
FR-005 requires multiple-comparison corrections. Task T030 is incomplete, so the Bonferroni correction logic is missing.
SC-003 requires measuring total execution time. Task T032b (measure_runtime.py) is marked incomplete. The constraint cannot be verified.

FR-003 requires a 'failure topology' analysis (implied by Edge Cases and T036). Task T033 (classify_failures.py) and T036 (analyze_failure_topology.py) are marked incomplete. The qualitative analysis of failure types is missing.
FR-001 requires filtering for ≥200 valid pairs. Task T014 (validation logic for ≥200 entries) is marked incomplete. The system cannot verify the minimum corpus size.
FR-001 requires excluding corrupted entries. Task T013b (validation logic) is marked complete, but T016 (logging excluded entries) is incomplete. The traceability of excluded data is missing.
FR-002 requires deterministic execution. Task T022 (pinning seeds/logging) is marked incomplete. Reproducibility (Constitution I) is at risk.
FR-002 requires handling non-code outputs. Task T024 (log 'failed translation') is marked incomplete. The system cannot distinguish between translation failures and API errors.
FR-005 requires generating a final statistical summary. Task T031 (generate statistical_summary.csv) is marked incomplete. The primary output artifact is missing.
FR-003 requires a 'failure topology' report. Task T034 (generate failure_topology_report.csv) is marked incomplete. The structured failure analysis is missing.
FR-003 requires integrating failure topology into the summary. Task T035 is marked incomplete. The final report will lack the required qualitative dimension.
FR-003 requires a qualitative analysis of failure structure. Task T036 is marked incomplete. The 'david-krakauer-simulated' review concern regarding failure topology is not addressed.
Plan element 'quickstart.md' validation. Task T043 (Run quickstart.md validation) is marked incomplete. The end-to-end reproducibility check is missing.
Plan element 'Documentation'. Task T039 (Documentation updates) is marked incomplete. The quickstart guide and pipeline documentation are missing.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksumming. Task T006 is marked complete, but T015 (integrate checksum into US1) is incomplete. The checksum workflow is not fully integrated into the data pipeline.
Constitution Principle V (Versioning) requires state updates. Task T007 is marked complete, but T032 (integrate state update into US3) is incomplete. The final state update is missing.
Constitution Principle VI (Prompt Integrity) requires logging prompt text. Task T022 is incomplete, and T025b (raw log) is incomplete. The prompt text logging is not guaranteed.
Constitution Principle VI requires a version-controlled metadata log. Task T025c (generate_metadata_log.py) is marked incomplete. The version-controlled record of experimental conditions is missing.
Constitution Principle VII (Evaluation Transparency) requires statistical rigor. Task T030 is incomplete, so the statistical tests are not implemented.
Constitution Principle VII requires a deterministic CSV for results. Task T031 is incomplete, so the results CSV is not generated.
Constitution Principle VII requires p-values and CIs in the paper. Task T031 is incomplete, so these values are not available for the paper.
Constitution Principle VII requires a changelog for deviations. No task exists to implement a changelog mechanism for deviations from the evaluation pipeline.
Constitution Principle VII requires a sensitivity analysis for alpha. No task exists to implement the sensitivity analysis for alpha values.
Constitution Principle VII requires a fixed statistical library version. Task T030 is incomplete, so the library version is not enforced in the analysis script.
Constitution Principle VII requires a changelog for deviations. No task exists to implement a changelog mechanism for deviations from the evaluation pipeline.
Constitution Principle VII requires a sensitivity analysis for alpha. No task exists to implement the sensitivity analysis for alpha values.
Constitution Principle VII requires a fixed statistical library version. Task T030 is incomplete, so the library version is not enforced in the analysis script.
